name: lean-ctx
description: The LeanCTX cockpit (Select · Control · Prove sidebar, pulse line, turn and milestone overlays), wake on background job completion, remove redundant lean-ctx hook context, shape native Bash output, keep core tools in front, and show per-session usage.

front_loaded_tools.title: Front-loaded lean-ctx tools
front_loaded_tools.description: Lean-ctx MCP tool names to keep in the prompt; all other lean-ctx tools stay deferred.

shape_native_output.title: Shape native Bash output
shape_native_output.description: Compress large native Bash stdout through lean-ctx (recoverable); off keeps it byte-for-byte.

keep_hook_context.title: Keep lean-ctx hook context
keep_hook_context.description: Keep lean-ctx SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit context from settings hooks.
